result:
If I could pick one change and have it just be true everywhere, it would be to make people incapable of believing they are an exception to the moral rules they expect others to follow.

Not more intelligence, not more wealth, not a technological fix. Just that sudden, internal consistency where the empathy you want from the world is automatically applied to the people you disagree with, the people you find inconvenient, the people who are not like you.

Everything else — cooperation, climate action, less cruelty, better science, less waste — flows from that one shift.
